releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.16 - Intelligent Ad Skipping & Autonomous Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
v1.0.16 Update:
* Static Ads Support: Full detection of non-video static ads with CTA/Attribution/Container identification.
* Volume/Mute Control Shielding: Smart differentiation between audio toggles and ad close buttons across all 4 screen corners.
* Accurate Episode Count & Limit Binding: Fixed double-counting and bound exact episode limits to continuous unlock state machine.
* Overlay Persistence & Clamping: Protected overlay service with START_STICKY, orientation change clamping, and background health checks.
